title: Medical Illustration Design Characteristic Evaluation
official: Advancing Medical Illustration in Patient Education Materials: From Art to Science. Study 1: Medical Illustration Design Characteristic Evaluation
summary: The goal of this study is to understand what people understand from medical illustrations, and what meaning and emotions (such as anxiety) they derive from different design elements.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Over 18 years old
* Speaks English or Spanish ﬂuently
* Is able to independently consent
* Has adequate corrected vision to read patient education documents

Exclusion Criteria:

\* None
